mcp_tools.name: transcribe_audio
mcp_tools.description:
Transcribe spoken audio in an Indian language or English to text.

Handles files of any duration by slicing into <=30s chunks at natural speech pauses.

Args:
    file_path: Path to the audio file on disk (WAV, MP3, etc.).
    language: ISO language code (e.g. 'hi', 'ta', 'te'). If omitted, auto-detected.
    task: 'transcribe' for verbatim speech-to-text, or 'translate' for direct English.

mcp_tools.name: translate_text
mcp_tools.description:
Translate text between Indian languages and English using Indic-Translate.

Args:
    text: Source text to translate.
    target_language: Target ISO code (e.g. 'en', 'hi', 'ta', 'te', 'bn', 'mr').
    source_language: Source ISO code, optional. Accepted and validated, but
        intentionally not embedded in the model instruction: naming the source
        makes the live indic-translate deployment echo the input instead of
        translating. Output is validated to contain target-script characters
        before being returned (an echo becomes an honest ToolError).

mcp_tools.name: synthesize_speech
mcp_tools.description:
Synthesize speech from text in an Indian language or English using Indic-Speak.

Automatically splits long text into prosodic sentences along Danda/punctuation
boundaries and stitches the resulting 24kHz audio into one file.

Args:
    text: Indian-language or English text to speak.
    language: ISO code (e.g. 'ta', 'hi', 'bn', 'mr', 'te').
    voice: Preferred voice name from the Bodhan voice catalog.
    style: Speaking style (e.g. 'AIR style news', 'news', 'happy').
    output_path: Where to save the WAV file. Defaults to speech_{language}.wav.

mcp_tools.name: extract_document_text
mcp_tools.description:
Extract text and structured tables from documents (PDF, DOCX, XPS, EPUB, TIFF) or images (PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP, GIF).

For DOCX, paragraphs and tables are extracted directly with zero external dependencies.
For multi-page documents (PDF, XPS, EPUB, MOBI, TIFF), pages are rasterized into images and extracted with Indic-OCR.
For images, text is extracted via Indic-OCR with automatic format normalization.

Args:
    file_path: Path to the document or image file on disk.
    table_format: Format for extracted tables ('markdown' or 'html').
    page_limit: Maximum pages to process for multi-page documents.

mcp_tools.name: inspect_media
mcp_tools.description:
Inspect audio, image, or document metadata without making paid LLM calls.

Args:
    file_path: Path to the media file on disk.

mcp_tools.name: chunk_audio
mcp_tools.description:
Slice a long audio file (WAV, MP3, OGG, WebM, etc.) at silence dips into chunks under max_chunk_sec.

Args:
    file_path: Path to the input audio file on disk.
    max_chunk_sec: Maximum slice duration in seconds (must be <= 30.0).

mcp_tools.name: read_text_file
mcp_tools.description:
Read a text file from disk safely using bounded character pagination.

Shields the caller from context window flooding when opening large text
documents, transcripts, or subtitles. Returns JSON with metadata including
total file size, current offset, character count returned, whether more text
remains, and the text slice. Free (zero API cost).

Args:
    file_path: Path to the text file on disk.
    offset: Character index to start reading from (default 0).
    limit: Maximum number of characters to read in this slice (default 10,000).

mcp_tools.name: write_text_file
mcp_tools.description:
Write text content to a file on disk.

Use this to save generated artifacts: SRT subtitles, translated
Markdown, summaries, or any text output. Creates parent directories
automatically. Free (no API cost).

Args:
    file_path: Destination path for the file (e.g. 'subtitles.srt' or 'artifacts/subtitles.srt').
    content: Text content to write.

mcp_tools.name: detect_language
mcp_tools.description:
Detect the script and likely language of text using Unicode analysis.

Free (no API call). Identifies the dominant script block (Devanagari,
Tamil, Bengali, etc.) and returns the most likely ISO language codes.
Useful when the input language is unstated.

Note: Devanagari is shared by Hindi, Marathi, Sanskrit, Nepali, etc.
Use task context to disambiguate.

Args:
    text: Text to analyze (at least a few words for reliable detection).

mcp_tools.name: get_cache_stats
mcp_tools.description:
Retrieve runtime diagnostics, hit ratio, and disk metrics for the Indic API cache.

Returns JSON metrics including total hits, misses, hit ratio percentage,
total latency saved, disk usage, and breakdown per Indic tool.

mcp_tools.name: clear_cache
mcp_tools.description:
Clear all entries or entries for a specific tool from the Indic API cache.

Args:
    tool_name: Optional tool name ('translate_text', 'transcribe_audio',
        'synthesize_speech', 'extract_document_text'). If omitted, clears all entries.

control_tools.name: submit_plan
control_tools.description: Submit structured execution plan assessing feasibility, steps, and assumptions before tool execution.

feasible.description: Whether the task is feasible with Indic AI capabilities.

infeasibility_reason.description: Reason why the task is infeasible, if feasible=false.

control_tools.name: finish
control_tools.description: Conclude task execution with status, final answer, generated artifacts, and validated assumptions.

answer.description: Final detailed answer or summary of results.

artifacts.description: List of generated artifact file paths.

assumptions.description: Assumptions maintained or validated during execution.
